description: Brew the numbered effect seals in order. Jar courses are concealed: sample a jar in the mortar to learn its course, then use the retained marks and local preview to choose ingredients and grind. Shelf order varies by brew. Sampling and previews are safe before LIGHT CAULDRON; after lighting, each deliberate control advances currents, seals and bone rafts through one fixed course segment, while waiting leaves the atlas stable. Grinding bends a course clockwise by up to 90 degrees. Stir controls propulsion and water pulls toward the origin. Keep the whole flask inside a seal, moving slowly relative to it, until its ring fills. Bone or rim contact loses the brew. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
name: Apothecary Dead Reckoning V3 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Brew the numbered seals. Sample concealed jar courses in the mortar by dragging jars; retained marks and the local preview guide ingredient and grind choices. Each deliberate post-start control advances one fixed atlas segment; waiting is stable. Use grind, stir and water to steer, stay inside each moving seal at low relative speed, and avoid bone or rim contact.
